findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: fetch, search_legislation, get_saved_role_view, list_topics, get_topic, list_review_queue, list_follows, request_ingestion, get_ingestion_result · Private data: lookup_provision, list_saved_role_views, get_saved_role_view, provision_context, define_term, work_glossary, concept_family, work_mentions, provision_history, find_national_implementations, guidance_for_provision, list_follows, request_ingestion, list_ingestion_requests · Public sink: list_follows, request_ingestion · Destructive: list_follows.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: fetch, search_legislation, get_saved_role_view, list_topics, get_topic, list_review_queue, list_follows, request_ingestion, get_ingestion_result · Private data: lookup_provision, list_saved_role_views, get_saved_role_view, provision_context, define_term, work_glossary, concept_family, work_mentions, provision_history, find_national_implementations, guidance_for_provision, list_follows, request_ingestion, list_ingestion_requests · Public sink: list_follows, request_ingestion · Destructive: list_follows

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
